detail.readme_excerpt:
Animated React components for websites people remember.

215+ free animated components and backgrounds for React.
Tune them yourself, or hand them to your agent.

Documentation · Installation · MCP · Tools · Pro


## What's inside Every component has a live demo with controls, and comes in four flavors: JavaScript or TypeScript, styled with CSS or Tailwind. | Category | Count | What you'll find | | ---------------------------------------------------------- | ----: | ----------------------------------------------------------------- | | [Text Animations](https://reactbits.dev/c/text-animations) | 33 | Split text, typewriters, rotating words and scroll reveals | | [Animations](https://reactbits.dev/c/animations) | 38 | Cursor effects, hover interactions, borders and image effects | | [Components](https://reactbits.dev/c/components) | 48 | Cards, navigation, carousels and galleries | | [Micro](https://reactbits.dev/c/micro) | 34 | Buttons, toggles, indicator
